properties.name: Kedarnath Himalayan Tsunami
properties.history: Worst disaster in modern Indian history. Mandakini river flooded. Over 5000 dead/missing.

properties.name: Beas River Surge
properties.history: Beas river reached record levels in Mandi town. Historic Panchvaktra temple partially submerged.

properties.name: Rishiganga Disaster
properties.history: Sudden flood in Rishiganga/Dhauliganga. Destroyed Tapovan Vishnugad hydel project. Over 200 fatalities.

properties.name: Bhagsunag Flash Flood
properties.history: Intense cloudburst caused a massive flash flood in Bhagsunag area of McLeod Ganj.

properties.name: Manali NH Washout
properties.history: Large sections of the Manali-Chandigarh National Highway were washed away by the Beas river.

properties.name: Srinagar Inundation
properties.history: Major flooding in Srinagar town area as Alakhnanda river breached the banks.

properties.name: Tozing Nallah Flash Flood
properties.history: Sudden flood in Tozing nallah near Udaipur washed away several people and vehicles.

properties.name: Ravi River Flood
properties.history: Heavy discharge in Ravi river inundated low-lying areas of Chamba town and damaged bridges.

properties.name: Haridwar Ganga Surge
properties.history: Ganga river crossed the danger mark at Har Ki Pauri, affecting nearby ghats and colonies.

properties.name: Swan River Inundation
properties.history: Seasonal flooding in the Swan river 'River of Sorrow' affected agricultural land in Una district.

properties.name: Parvati Valley Surge
properties.history: Flash flood in seasonal streams in Kasol and Manikaran areas washed away tents and vehicles.

properties.name: Gaula River Bridge Washout
properties.history: A major approach road and part of the Gaula river bridge in Kathgodam were washed away.

properties.name: Satluj River High Discharge
properties.history: Record water levels in Satluj river affected SJVN's Nathpa Jhakri project and Rampur town.

properties.name: Kosi River Flooding
properties.history: The Kosi river in Almora overflowed its banks due to extreme rainfall, damaging resorts and fields.

properties.name: Sangla Baspa Flash Flood
properties.history: Flash flood in Baspa river damaged the strategic road and irrigation channels in Sangla valley.

properties.name: Indora Beas Inundation
properties.history: Low-lying areas of Indora and Fatehpur were submerged due to heavy discharge from Pong Dam.

properties.name: Laksar Ganga Overflow
properties.history: Ganga and Solani rivers breached embankments, flooding Laksar town and dozens of villages.

properties.name: Pandoh Dam Discharge
properties.history: Massive release from Pandoh dam caused flash floods downstream in Beas river.

properties.name: Rishikesh Ganga Surge
properties.history: Triveni Ghat and nearby areas in Rishikesh were inundated as Ganga river flowed above danger mark.

properties.name: Baddi Industrial Flood
properties.history: Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh industrial belt saw heavy flooding, damaging factory units.

properties.name: Kashipur Urban Flooding
properties.history: Torrential rains caused severe waterlogging and flooding in residential colonies of Kashipur.

properties.name: Bhuntar Airport Surge
properties.history: Beas river overflowed into the Bhuntar airport runway and surrounding residential areas.

properties.name: Karnaprayag Confluence Flood
properties.history: Alaknanda and Pindar confluence witnessed record levels, washing away market buildings.

properties.name: Rohiru Pabbar River Flood
properties.history: Pabbar river flooded Rohiru town, causing damage to market areas and apple storage facilities.

properties.name: Kali River Dharchula Flood
properties.history: Sudden rise in Kali river levels inundated the lower market of Dharchula.

properties.name: Swan River Monsoon Surge
properties.history: Seasonal monsoon rains caused Swan river to overflow, affecting village connectivity.

properties.name: Ramnagar Kosi Flood
properties.history: Kosi river flooded parts of Ramnagar town and Corbett fringe areas.

properties.name: Ravi River Chamba Town
properties.history: Ravi river levels rose above the danger mark, inundating low-lying residential colonies.

properties.name: Kosi River Almora Sector
properties.history: Heavy monsoon rains caused the Kosi river to flood agricultural terraces along its bank.

properties.name: Govind Sagar Backwater Rise
properties.history: High inflows into Bhakra dam caused backwaters to rise, affecting lakeside fields in Bilaspur.

properties.name: Bhagirathi Flood Uttarkashi
properties.history: Bhagirathi river caused massive destruction in Uttarkashi town during the 2013 disaster.

properties.name: Beas River Nadaun Flood
properties.history: Beas river levels rose significantly at Nadaun, affecting ferry services and riverside fields.

properties.name: Saryu River Bageshwar
properties.history: Saryu and Gomti rivers confluenced at high levels, flooding the Baghnath temple area.

properties.name: Giri River Paonta Flood
properties.history: Giri river in Paonta Sahib witnessed high discharge, affecting riverside settlements.

properties.name: Kotdwar Khoh River Flood
properties.history: Khoh river flooded residential areas of Kotdwar following extreme rain in the hills.

properties.name: Chandra River Sissu Flood
properties.history: Chandra river levels rose significantly, causing minor flooding in Sissu and nearby areas.

properties.name: Pindar River Tharali Flood
properties.history: Pindar river witnessed sudden surge, washing away small bridges in Tharali block.

properties.name: Pong Dam Spillway Impact
properties.history: Spillway discharge from Pong Dam caused riverine flooding in Beas downstream villages.

properties.name: Asi River Raipur Flood
properties.history: Asi river in Raipur area of Dehradun caused major flash floods damaging houses and roads.

properties.name: Suketi Khad Mandi Flood
properties.history: Suketi Khad in Mandi town overflowed, damaging properties along its banks.

properties.name: Parvati Valley Flash Flood
properties.history: July 2023: Sudden rise in Parvati river levels. Several campsites in Kasol and Manikaran swept away. Major disruption to tourism infrastructure.

properties.name: Samej Flash Flood
properties.history: August 1, 2024: Massive cloudburst at Samej Khud. Entire village hamlets wiped out. Over 30 people missing or dead. Hydel project infrastructure destroyed.

properties.name: Chandra River Surge
properties.history: Summer 2023: Unusual flash floods in Lahaul valley due to combined effects of heavy rain and rapid snow melt. Blocked Atal Tunnel access roads.

properties.name: Ravi River Flash Flood
properties.history: July 2023: Ravi river caused extensive damage to Chamba-Pathankot highway. Local bridges and hydro-power intakes damaged.

properties.name: Nagwain Overflow
properties.remarks: Minor localized flooding due to river backflow.

properties.name: Swan River Spill
properties.remarks: Seasonal overflow affecting low-lying agriculture fields.
